definitions.explanation: The process of something lasting longer than expected or originally planned, typically with negative implications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{長期化|ちょうきか}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The construction work has become prolonged.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長期化|ちょうきか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There are concerns about the conflict becoming prolonged.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長期化|ちょうきか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The prolongation of the trial is placing a greater burden on the victims.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧ (long-term) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation suffix) = becoming long-term/prolonged.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長期化|ちょうきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become prolonged)
- {長期化|ちょうきか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ (risk of prolongation)
- {長期化|ちょうきか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid prolongation)

USAGE:
{長期化|ちょうきか} almost always carries a negative nuance — something is dragging on longer than desired. It is common in news reports about conflicts, lawsuits, economic downturns, and other ongoing situations.

SIMILAR 〜{化|か} WORDS:
- ⟦{深刻化|しんこくか}→深刻化：11107_shinkokuka⟧ (worsening)
- {慢性化|まんせいか} (becoming chronic)
- ⟦{常態化|じょうたいか}→常態化：08024_joutaika⟧ (becoming the norm)
